{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794717601323,"sessionID":"ses_e228b82ebffe4am8cJu0qAa0Yt","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"AetMgpDMEcUZUTls","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"python3 -c '\nimport math\ncands = [\"e18\", \"e08\", \"e13\", \"e15\", \"e23\", \"e31\"]\nc1_2 = {\"e08\":\"v2\", \"e13\":\"v3\", \"e15\":\"v3\", \"e18\":\"v2\", \"e23\":\"v3\", \"e31\":\"v1\"}\nc2_2 = {\"e08\":\"v1\", \"e13\":\"v2\", \"e15\":\"v3\"} # others none\n\n# Access logs days 1..4 for these 6:\nlogs = {\n  \"e08\": (4, 0), # d1:2, d2:1, d3:1, d4:0\n  \"e13\": (3, 1), # d1:0, d2:0+1ah, d3:2, d4:1\n  \"e15\": (6, 2), # d1:1, d2:2+1ah, d3:2+1ah, d4:1\n  \"e18\": (2, 1), # d1:0, d2:2+1ah, d3:0, d4:0\n  \"e23\": (6, 0), # d1:0, d2:1, d3:2, d4:3\n  \"e31\": (3, 0), # d1:1, d2:0, d3:1, d4:1\n}\n# Interviews so far: e18 (normal: 0.76 vs 0.80), e15 (normal: 0.76 vs 0.80), e13 (evasive: 0.24 vs 0.20)\niv_lr = {\"e18\": 0.76/0.80, \"e15\": 0.76/0.80, \"e13\": 0.24/0.20, \"e08\": 1.0, \"e23\": 1.0, \"e31\": 1.0}\n\n# Under default random mole:\n# Day 1: all 6 held d1-2 (1.0) + c1-2 (0.65) -> same P(d1-2) = 1/1.65\n# Day 2:\n#   e18, e23, e31 held d2-1 (1.0) + c1-2 (0.65) -> P(d2-1) = 1 / 1.65 = 0.6061\n#   e08, e13, e15 held d2-1 (1.0) + c1-2 (0.65) + c2-2 (0.675) -> P(d2-1) = 1 / 2.325 = 0.4301\n# Day 3:\n#   e18, e23, e31 held ONLY c1-2 -> P(c1-2) = 1.0\n#   e08, e13, e15 held c1-2 (0.65) + c2-2 (0.675) -> P(c1-2) = 0.65 / 1.325 = 0.4906\n\nfor rule_mode in [\"random\", \"most_recipients\"]:\n    print(f\"=== Mode: {rule_mode} ===\")\n    post = {}\n    for e in cands:\n        reg, ah = logs[e]\n        # 4 days: mole reg ~ Pois(2.8), ah ~ Pois(1.2); inn reg ~ Pois(3.6), ah ~ Pois(4*0.128 = 0.512)\n        ll_mole = -2.8 + reg * math.log(2.8) - 1.2 + ah * math.log(1.2)\n        ll_inn = -3.6 + reg * math.log(3.6) - 0.512 + ah * math.log(0.512)\n        log_lr = math.exp(ll_mole - ll_inn)\n        fp = 0.95 if c1_2[e] == \"v2\" else 0.025\n        if rule_mode == \"random\":\n            sel = (0.6061 * 1.0) if e not in c2_2 else (0.4301 * 0.4906)\n        else:\n            # most_recipients: Day 1 d1-2(17)>c1-2(14) -> 1.0; Day 2 d2-1(19)>14>13 -> 1.0; Day 3 c1-2(14)>c2-2(13) -> 1.0!\n            sel = 1.0\n        post[e] = log_lr * fp * sel * iv_lr[e]\n    tot = sum(post.values())\n    for e in sorted(cands, key=lambda x: -post[x]):\n        print(f\"  {e}: P = {post[e]/tot:.4f} (reg={logs[e][0]}, ah={logs[e][1]}, var={c1_2[e]})\")\n'"},"output":"=== Mode: random ===\n  e18: P = 0.8889 (reg=2, ah=1, var=v2)\n  e08: P = 0.0841 (reg=4, ah=0, var=v2)\n  e31: P = 0.0082 (reg=3, ah=0, var=v1)\n  e13: P = 0.0080 (reg=3, ah=1, var=v3)\n  e15: P = 0.0070 (reg=6, ah=2, var=v3)\n  e23: P = 0.0038 (reg=6, ah=0, var=v3)\n=== Mode: most_recipients ===\n  e18: P = 0.7498 (reg=2, ah=1, var=v2)\n  e08: P = 0.2037 (reg=4, ah=0, var=v2)\n  e13: P = 0.0194 (reg=3, ah=1, var=v3)\n  e15: P = 0.0169 (reg=6, ah=2, var=v3)\n  e31: P = 0.0069 (reg=3, ah=0, var=v1)\n  e23: P = 0.0032 (reg=6, ah=0, var=v3)\n","metadata":{"output":"=== Mode: random ===\n  e18: P = 0.8889 (reg=2, ah=1, var=v2)\n  e08: P = 0.0841 (reg=4, ah=0, var=v2)\n  e31: P = 0.0082 (reg=3, ah=0, var=v1)\n  e13: P = 0.0080 (reg=3, ah=1, var=v3)\n  e15: P = 0.0070 (reg=6, ah=2, var=v3)\n  e23: P = 0.0038 (reg=6, ah=0, var=v3)\n=== Mode: most_recipients ===\n  e18: P = 0.7498 (reg=2, ah=1, var=v2)\n  e08: P = 0.2037 (reg=4, ah=0, var=v2)\n  e13: P = 0.0194 (reg=3, ah=1, var=v3)\n  e15: P = 0.0169 (reg=6, ah=2, var=v3)\n  e31: P = 0.0069 (reg=3, ah=0, var=v1)\n  e23: P = 0.0032 (reg=6, ah=0, var=v3)\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"python3 -c '\nimport math\ncands = [\"e18\", \"e08\", \"e13\", \"e15\", \"e23\", \"e31\"]\nc1_2 = {\"e08\":\"v2\", \"e13\":\"v3\", \"e15\":\"v3\", \"e18\":\"v2\", \"e23\":\"v3\", \"e31\":\"v1\"}\nc2_2 = {\"e08\":\"v1\", \"e13\":\"v2\", \"e15\":\"v3\"} # others none\n\n# Access logs days 1..4 for these 6:\nlogs = {\n  \"e08\": (4, 0), # d1:2, d2:1, d3:1, d4:0\n  \"e13\": (3, 1), # d1:0, d2:0+1ah, d3:2, d4:1\n  \"e15\": (6, 2), # d1:1, d2:2+1ah, d3:2+1ah, d4:1\n  \"e18\": (2, 1), # d1:0, d2:2+1ah, d3:0, d4:0\n  \"e23\": (6, 0), # d1:0, d2:1, d3:2, d4:3\n  \"e31\": (3, 0), # d1:1, d2:0, d3:1, d4:1\n}\n# Interviews so far: e18 (normal: 0.76 vs 0.80), e15 (normal: 0.76 vs 0.80), e13 (evasive: 0.24 vs 0.20)\niv_lr = {\"e18\": 0.76/0.80, \"e15\": 0.76/0.80, \"e13\": 0.24/0.20, \"e08\": 1.0, \"e23\": 1.0, \"e31\": 1.0}\n\n# Under default random mole:\n# Day 1: all 6 held d1-2 (1.0) + c1-2 (0.65) -> same P(d1-2) = 1/1.65\n# Day 2:\n#   e18, e23, e31 held d2-1 (1.0) + c1-2 (0.65) -> P(d2-1) = 1 / 1.65 = 0.6061\n#   e08, e13, e15 held d2-1 (1.0) + c1-2 (0.65) + c2-2 (0.675) -> P(d2-1) = 1 / 2.325 = 0.4301\n# Day 3:\n#   e18, e23, e31 held ONLY c1-2 -> P(c1-2) = 1.0\n#   e08, e13, e15 held c1-2 (0.65) + c2-2 (0.675) -> P(c1-2) = 0.65 / 1.325 = 0.4906\n\nfor rule_mode in [\"random\", \"most_recipients\"]:\n    print(f\"=== Mode: {rule_mode} ===\")\n    post = {}\n    for e in cands:\n        reg, ah = logs[e]\n        # 4 days: mole reg ~ Pois(2.8), ah ~ Pois(1.2); inn reg ~ Pois(3.6), ah ~ Pois(4*0.128 = 0.512)\n        ll_mole = -2.8 + reg * math.log(2.8) - 1.2 + ah * math.log(1.2)\n        ll_inn = -3.6 + reg * math.log(3.6) - 0.512 + ah * math.log(0.512)\n        log_lr = math.exp(ll_mole - ll_inn)\n        fp = 0.95 if c1_2[e] == \"v2\" else 0.025\n        if rule_mode == \"random\":\n            sel = (0.6061 * 1.0) if e not in c2_2 else (0.4301 * 0.4906)\n        else:\n            # most_recipients: Day 1 d1-2(17)>c1-2(14) -> 1.0; Day 2 d2-1(19)>14>13 -> 1.0; Day 3 c1-2(14)>c2-2(13) -> 1.0!\n            sel = 1.0\n        post[e] = log_lr * fp * sel * iv_lr[e]\n    tot = sum(post.values())\n    for e in sorted(cands, key=lambda x: -post[x]):\n        print(f\"  {e}: P = {post[e]/tot:.4f} (reg={logs[e][0]}, ah={logs[e][1]}, var={c1_2[e]})\")\n'","time":{"start":1794717601275,"end":1794717601320}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dd814de1001pC1B36217NAlzh","sessionID":"ses_e228b82ebffe4am8cJu0qAa0Yt","messageID":"msg_1dd8088170016zEHlq1d32TVMm"}}

weight 0.675\nc4 = {\"e18\":\"v1\", \"e15\":\"v2\", \"e23\":\"v3\", \"e31\":\"v3\"} # weight 0.85\n# all 6 got c4-2 (weight 0.45) and d4-1, d4-2, d4-4 (weight 1.0 each)\n\n# Day 5 access logs:\n# e08: 0, e13: 0, e15: 0, e18: 0, e23: 1 reg, e31: 2 reg\nlogs = {\n  \"e08\": (4, 0),\n  \"e13\": (3, 1),\n  \"e15\": (6, 2),\n  \"e18\": (2, 1),\n  \"e23\": (7, 0),\n  \"e31\": (5, 0),\n}\n# Interviews:\n# e18: 3 normal -> (0.76/0.80)^3\n# e08: 2 normal -> (0.76/0.80)^2\n# e15: 1 normal -> (0.76/0.80)^1\n# e13: 1 evasive -> (0.24/0.20)^1\niv_lr = {\n  \"e18\": (0.76/0.80)**3,\n  \"e08\": (0.76/0.80)**2,\n  \"e15\": (0.76/0.80)**1,\n  \"e13\": (0.24/0.20)**1,\n  \"e23\": 1.0,\n  \"e31\": 1.0,\n}\n\npost = {}\nfor e in cands:\n    reg, ah = logs[e]\n    # 5 days: mole reg ~ Pois(3.5), ah ~ Pois(1.5); inn reg ~ Pois(4.5), ah ~ Pois(5*0.128 = 0.64)\n    ll_mole = -3.5 + reg * math.log(3.5) - 1.5 + ah * math.log(1.5)\n    ll_inn = -4.5 + reg * math.log(4.5) - 0.64 + ah * math.log(0.64)\n    log_lr = math.exp(ll_mole - ll_inn)\n    fp = 0.95 if c1_2[e] == \"v2\" else 0.025\n    # 5 days: mole reg ~ Pois(3.5), ah ~ Pois(1.5); inn reg ~ Pois(4.5), ah ~ Pois(5*0.128 = 0.64)\n    ll_mole = -3.5 + reg * math.log(3.5) - 1.5 + ah * math.log(1.5)\n    ll_inn = -4.5 + reg * math.log(4.5) - 0.64 + ah * math.log(0.64)\n    log_lr = math.exp(ll_mole - ll_inn)\n    fp = 0.95 if c1_2[e] == \"v2\" else 0.025\n    # d4-1(1), d4-2(1), d4-4(1), c4-2(0.45), plus c2-2(0.675 if in c2_2), plus c4(0.85 if in c4)\n    w_d4 = 3.0 + 0.45 + (0.675 if e in c2_2 else 0.0) + (0.85 if e in c4 else 0.0)\n    p_d4 = 1.0 / w_d4\n    post[e] = log_lr * fp * p_d2 * p_d3 * p_d4 * iv_lr[e]\n\ntot = sum(post.values())\nfor e in sorted(cands, key=lambda x: -post[x]):\n    print(f\"  {e}: P = {post[e]/tot:.4f} (reg={logs[e][0]}, ah={logs[e][1]})\")\n'","time":{"start":1794717685350,"end":1794717685380}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dd82964d001Si17x0i4gEo8WQ","sessionID":"ses_e228b82ebffe4am8cJu0qAa0Yt","messageID":"msg_1dd8232fd001orzP8qoCaRahYp"}}
